quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Morning to get ready to head out the door"?
quests.question: Get Dressed
quests.hint: Buttons, zippers, and sleeves are all part of this task.
quests.explanation: That's right! Getting dressed means changing out of pajamas into daytime clothes.
quests.funFact: Many schools have a favorite color or uniform that students wear when they get dressed!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning to keep your shoes snug with a simple knot"?
quests.question: Tie Shoelaces
quests.hint: This keeps your shoes snug so they won't slip off.
quests.explanation: That's right! Tying shoelaces means making a neat knot to keep shoes secure.
quests.funFact: Some sneakers use velcro instead of laces to make getting dressed even faster!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Evening to soak in warm water before bedtime"?
quests.question: Take a Bath
quests.hint: You do this before you put on your pajamas.
quests.explanation: That's right! A warm bath helps us relax before bedtime.
quests.funFact: Bath time is a great time to sing a silly song while you splash!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Morning to open your eyes and start a brand new day"?
quests.question: Wake Up
quests.hint: You do this before you even get out of bed.
quests.explanation: Correct! Waking up gets us ready for a whole day of learning and play.
quests.funFact: Getting enough sleep at night helps you wake up feeling happy and ready to play!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Afternoon to snuggle up for a short bit of rest"?
quests.question: Take a Nap
quests.hint: A soft blanket and a quiet room help with this one.
quests.explanation: That's right! A short nap helps us feel refreshed for the rest of the day.
quests.funFact: Even grown-ups sometimes enjoy a short afternoon nap to feel refreshed!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Night to share a gentle goodbye before the lights go off"?
quests.question: Say Good Night
quests.hint: A hug or a kiss often comes along with these words.
quests.explanation: That's right! Saying good night is a warm way to end our day.
quests.funFact: Families all around the world have their own special way of saying good night!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Anytime to quench your thirst after running and playing"?
quests.question: Drink Water
quests.hint: You often do this after running or playing outside.
quests.explanation: Well done! Water is what our busy bodies need to stay healthy.
quests.funFact: Drinking water instead of sugary drinks is a great habit for a healthy body!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Afternoon to run, jump, and enjoy the fresh air"?
quests.question: Play Outside
quests.hint: This is active and usually happens outdoors, not inside.
quests.explanation: Well done! Fresh air and sunshine make playing outside extra fun.
quests.funFact: Playing outside is a great way to get exercise while having lots of fun!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Morning to get a lunchbox ready before you leave for school"?
quests.question: Pack a Lunch
quests.hint: You do this before school, but you eat the food much later.
quests.explanation: That's right! Packing a lunch means choosing food to eat later at school.
quests.funFact: Some children like to pack their own lunch and choose their favorite foods!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning to walk along the sidewalk toward your school"?
quests.question: Walk to School
quests.hint: Holding a grown-up's hand can help keep you safe during this one.
quests.explanation: Well done! Walking to school helps wake up our bodies before class.
quests.funFact: Looking both ways before crossing the street keeps you safe on your walk!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Morning to fill a bowl before adding a splash of milk"?
quests.question: Pour Cereal
quests.hint: This makes a crunchy start to your breakfast.
quests.explanation: That's right! Pouring cereal is a fast way to get breakfast ready.
quests.funFact: Whole grain cereals can give you energy that lasts through your whole morning!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Morning to pour a little water into a plant's pot"?
quests.question: Water the Plants
quests.hint: A small watering can helps with this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We water the plants so they stay green and healthy.
quests.funFact: Some houseplants only need a little water once or twice a week!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Night to look ahead so you know what to pack for tomorrow"?
quests.question: Check Tomorrow's Weather
quests.hint: This helps you plan what to wear before you even wake up.
quests.explanation: Yes! We check tomorrow's weather at night to help us plan ahead.
quests.funFact: Weather forecasters use science to help us guess what tomorrow's sky might look like!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Afternoon to finish the extra practice your teacher gave you"?
quests.question: Do Homework
options: Get Everything Ready the Night Before 🌙
quests.hint: A pencil and a quiet space help with this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We do homework in the afternoon to practice what we learned.
quests.funFact: Finding a quiet, comfy spot can make homework time easier to focus on!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Morning to smooth out your sheets and fluff your pillow"?
quests.question: Make Bed
quests.hint: You smooth out sheets and fluff a pillow for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We make our bed in the morning to keep our room tidy.
quests.funFact: Making your bed each morning is a small task that can make your whole room feel tidy!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Night to plan the exact time you'll wake up"?
quests.question: Set an Alarm
quests.hint: A clock helps with this one, usually right before bed.
quests.explanation: Yes! We set an alarm at night to help us wake up on time.
quests.funFact: The very first alarm clocks were invented so people wouldn't oversleep for work!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Evening to put your playthings back where they belong"?
quests.question: Clean Up Toys
quests.hint: It leaves your floor clear and your room looking tidy.
quests.explanation: Well done! A tidy playroom is ready for more fun tomorrow.
quests.funFact: Putting toys away in the same spot each time makes them easy to find next time!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Night to rest your body after all your busy play"?
quests.question: Go to Bed
quests.hint: A cozy pillow and a warm blanket are clues for this one.
quests.explanation: Well done! A good night's sleep helps us grow strong and feel happy.
quests.funFact: Sleeping at night gives your busy body time to rest and grow strong!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Night to get your backpack ready before you go to sleep"?
quests.question: Pack Your School Bag for Tomorrow
quests.correctAnswer: Pack Your School Bag for Tomorrow 🎒
options: Pack Your School Bag for Tomorrow 🎒
quests.hint: It makes tomorrow's morning feel calmer and less rushed.
quests.explanation: That's right! Packing the night before means your bag is ready before you even wake up.
quests.funFact: Packing your bag the night before can save precious minutes on a busy school morning!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Afternoon to gather dust into a pile before it gets tracked around"?
quests.question: Sweep the Floor
quests.hint: Dust and crumbs are gathered into a small pile for this one.
quests.explanation: That's right! Sweeping means using a broom to gather dust into a pile.
quests.funFact: A broom's long bristles can reach into corners that are hard to clean!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Morning to wake up your muscles with a big, gentle stretch"?
quests.question: Stretch Your Body
quests.hint: You do this gently, often right after you get out of bed.
quests.explanation: Well done! A gentle morning stretch can help us feel more awake.
quests.funFact: Stretching gently in the morning can help wake up your whole body!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning to put your bag away neatly right when you arrive"?
quests.question: Hang Up Your Backpack
quests.hint: You do this right after you arrive at school, not before you leave home.
quests.explanation: That's right! Hanging up a backpack means placing it neatly on a hook.
quests.funFact: A tidy hook area makes it easy to grab your backpack again after school!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Morning to share a warm greeting as the day begins"?
quests.question: Say Good Morning
quests.hint: You say this cheerful greeting right after you wake up.
quests.explanation: Yes! We say good morning to greet our family as the day begins.
quests.funFact: People around the world greet each other every morning in their own special way!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Evening to take out a full bag of household trash"?
quests.question: Empty the Trash
quests.hint: This keeps the whole house smelling clean and fresh.
quests.explanation: Well done! Emptying the trash helps keep our whole home clean and fresh.
quests.funFact: Many neighborhoods have a special collection day just for household trash!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Morning to bundle up warm before stepping into chilly air"?
quests.question: Put on a Coat
quests.hint: Zippers or buttons help keep this snug and warm.
quests.explanation: That's right! Putting on a coat means adding a warm layer before going outside.
quests.funFact: Checking the weather first can help you know if you'll need a coat that day!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning to glance left and right before stepping off the curb"?
quests.question: Look Both Ways
quests.hint: You do this at a crosswalk, right before crossing.
quests.explanation: Well done! Checking both ways keeps us safe on the way to school.
quests.funFact: Crosswalks and traffic lights help keep everyone safe while crossing busy streets!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Evening to help get everything ready before the family eats"?
quests.question: Set the Table
quests.hint: It helps get everyone ready to sit down and eat together.
quests.explanation: Well done! Helping set the table is a great way to help your family.
quests.funFact: Some families like to fold napkins into fun shapes when setting the table!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Evening to relax and enjoy a favorite show for a little while"?
quests.question: Watch Some TV
quests.hint: You might enjoy a cartoon or a favorite show during this time.
quests.explanation: Well done! A short show is a relaxing way to enjoy the evening.
quests.funFact: Balancing TV time with playing and reading helps keep your evening varied and fun!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Morning to slip on your favorite pair before school"?
quests.question: Put on Shoes
quests.hint: Laces, velcro, or buckles help keep these snug on your feet.
quests.explanation: That's right! Shoes protect our feet for walking, running, and playing.
quests.funFact: Wearing the right shoes helps keep your feet safe while you run and play!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Evening to water the plants growing outside in the ground"?
quests.question: Water the Garden
quests.hint: Flowers and vegetables both benefit from this one.
quests.explanation: Well done! A well-watered garden grows healthy flowers and vegetables.
quests.funFact: Gardens can grow colorful flowers and tasty vegetables with enough water and sunshine!
